history.title: A reconstructed history
history.caveat: No source tells this life: every particular of it is ours.
paragraphs: He was born about 1841 in Holstein and came to Chicago about 1851. He works as a butcher, and the household lives on the South Side near Clark Street. The family's church is St. Michael's.
